note: Attacker-controlled sample count read from the stz2 box payload. It fixes the number of entries in the compact sample-size table and therefore both the sizes array allocation size and the loop bound.
Field size 4 read from the box selects the 4-bit compact sample-size parsing path.
Guard only checks that floor(sampleCount/2) bytes are available; it passes for a one-byte table holding two 4-bit samples.
sizes array allocated with exactly sampleCount u32 entries; valid indices are 0..sampleCount-1.
First 4-bit sample size of the pair stored at sizes[i].
Second 4-bit sample size stored at sizes[i+1]; for even sampleCount this fills the final array entry.

Loop index advanced by two per iteration. After the last pair is processed i equals sampleCount (even count) or sampleCount+1 (odd count), i.e. past the end of the allocated sizes array, yet the following statements dereference ptr->sizes[i].

Out-of-bounds read sink: ptr->sizes[i] is dereferenced with i already advanced beyond sampleCount-1, reading past the end of the allocated sample-size array (and likewise used at line 5669 for total_size).
